body:
Stopped before claiming #1861 because its required dependency #1860 is unavailable on an allowed base.
Upstream main 6f8b309dcea9ea2c367ecfa53261ed140881bab3 has no crates/geometry/src/dxf module or the normalized DXF primitives requested here.
#1860 is still open. Its latest comment reports uncommitted work in .claude/worktrees/issue-1860, with no push or PR.
The open-PR search found no #1860 PR to stack on.
The prospective sketch-chaining files have no open-PR overlap.
No claim, branch, code change, test, or gate run was made for #1861.
The next attempt needs #1860 on upstream/main or in an eligible open PR that it can stack on.

Escalated effort:high to effort:max after inspecting the geometry APIs.
AGENTS.md assigns new geometry algorithms to effort:max. The work-issue skill requires escalation when the work needs a new algorithm.

boundary_chains::group_runs joins point lists in pick order using fixed quantized endpoint keys. It does not implement caller-tolerance curve chaining or stable curve identities.
geo2d::Region accepts polygon loops. It does not preserve arc metadata or provide the curve topology and identity layer requested here.
This issue needs new deterministic endpoint matching, curve-preserving traversal, canonical ChainId construction, and safe curved-loop classification.
Reusing group_runs directly would lose the required curve metadata and tolerance contract, so I rejected that approach.

The earlier dependency blocker has changed. #1860 now has open PR #1937 at e5204e0ef315584f32f4a699589c118f22abe4f1. It has merge-ready and no held label, and its body does not declare a stack.
Upstream main cda3d58965843c30c6c70d59c06ac27c4dcda8b0 still has no DXF reader module.
The next worker can stack on #1937 under the supplied stacking rule, after checking its current state.

Prospective files were crates/geometry/src/lib.rs, crates/geometry/src/sketch_chains/{mod,connect,nesting,identity}.rs, crates/geometry/tests/sketch_chains.rs, and docs/decisions/1861-sketch-chaining.md.
The per-file open-PR check found only #1937 in lib.rs. All other prospective paths had no overlap.

No claim was taken. No branch, worktree, code, tests, or gate run was created. No held patch exists. The issue remains free for the max-tier worker.
